title: [CQ-M07n3] Seat VM and per-task seat job, happy path (moe-agent.ps1)
description:
SPIDR split out of CQ-M07n (task-62ec51f179494706a39045154d07e544) by architect-30d804be on 2026-11-01. This is the PowerShell twin of CQ-M07m3 (task-3954cc09): the happy path. CQ-M07n keeps the error paths. Chain: mem:task-task-62ec51f179494706a39045154d07e544-handoff and mem:task-task-828e7d21602e4cf2a0f242e024db7dea-handoff.

**Depends on:**
- CQ-M07m3 (task-3954cc09). Its landed moe-agent.sh code is the source of every string, of the order of the steps and of the stub seam. Port it; never re-derive it. Through it come CQ-M07i (seat-start/seat-stop), CQ-M07j (seat-job), CQ-M07q (the claim marker) and CQ-M07k (vm-credential). Their contracts are in that row's description.
- CQ-M07n2 (task-d861f3de): the same files, and it provides the ps1 landing function.

**Objective.** Under verified-local and ready (CQ-M07n1's gate), a worker or QA seat of moe-agent.ps1 never runs its agent CLI on the host. It is the route the JetBrains launcher (CQ-M07o) uses on Windows.

**Deliverable.** In scripts/moe-agent.ps1, with rows in scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.ps1:
- **Seat start.** Run seat-start once, before the iteration's claim, when the seat holds no VM. Keep the instance for the whole wrapper pass.
  - Pass `--runner $script:MoeProcessStartedAt --host $script:MoeHost`, each as ONE argument.
  - Anything but ok refuses fail-closed, with CQ-M07m3's MOE_SEAT_START_FAILED line and exit 1.
- **Claim.** On VM-route iterations only, claim with `executionRoute = 'vm'` added to a per-iteration COPY of $claimRpcArgs, at both claim sites (the pre-flight claim and the single-shot wait's re-claims). A legacy iteration never carries it.
- **Post-claim backstop.** If the claim's workspace mode ($script:MoeWtMode) is not 'worktree', refuse with MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_SHARED_MODE_UNSUPPORTED before any job.
- **Job.** A new branch of the launch dispatch, before codex/gemini/grok/claude, runs `node <agent-seat> seat-job …` in place of the host CLI.
  - claude: the token comes from `Invoke-MoeAccountHelper vm-credential $script:AccountLeasedId`. It is wrapped as JSON {name, value} and piped to seat-job's stdin (`$json | & node …`), never as an argv, an env, a file or a log line.
  - Every seat-* spawn runs with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY and CODEX_API_KEY removed from the environment, restored in a finally, because the in-process supervisor keeps env across passes.
  - codex, and a missing token, fail closed here as CQ-M07m3 does; CQ-M07n adds the rest.
- **Outcome.** Relay the job's output. Parse the last stdout line marked "seatJob":1, and keep stderr records (5.1 ErrorRecords) apart from stdout lines.
  - The outcome's exitCode becomes $script:CliExitCode.
  - A worker's admitted tree goes through CQ-M07n2's function, then the normal post-flight.
  - QA lands nothing of its own.
- **Seat stop.** The outer finally runs seat-stop whenever the seat holds a VM, before Invoke-MoeDeregister. It is best-effort and bounded. That one funnel covers normal exit, Ctrl+C, terminating errors, `exit` and the hot-reload hand-over.
- **Placeholder and seam.**
  - Remove CQ-M07n1's MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_VM_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE placeholder.
  - Add CQ-M07m3's MOE_AGENT_SEAT_PATH stub seam, ignored when $script:MoeRuntimeProtected is set.
- **PowerShell 5.1 and 7.** Relax $ErrorActionPreference around native stderr. Check that seat-job's stdin reader accepts the trailing newline PowerShell's pipe appends; if it does not, write stdin through a System.Diagnostics.Process with RedirectStandardInput instead. Keep moe-agent.ps1 UTF-8 with a BOM.

**NOT in scope:**
- the capacity wait, seat-start failure details, codex credentials, missing-token escalation, a failed job and the hot-reload row (CQ-M07n);
- landing internals (CQ-M07n2);
- moe-agent.sh;
- the daemon.

**Verification.** Run from WSL (mem:gotcha-qa-ps1-postflight-from-wsl, mem:gotcha-pwsh7-reachable-from-wsl):
- `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\tests\postflight-vm-route.ps1`, then the same with pwsh.exe;
- then `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\tests\postflight.ps1` with MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC=180;
- then `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh`.
definitionOfDone: verified-local and ready, claude worker: the host CLI stub never runs; the agent-seat stub records seat-start, then seat-job, then seat-stop at exit, and the claim carries executionRoute 'vm' (row).
That worker job's admitted tree lands through CQ-M07n2's function onto moe/task/<id> (row).
A canary token from the vm-credential stub reaches seat-job only on stdin: it is absent from every recorded argv and env and from all wrapper output, under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and pwsh 7 (row).
seat-stop runs on a normal exit and on Ctrl+C sent mid-job with GenerateConsoleCtrlEvent, as postflight.ps1's interrupt supervisor sends it (rows).
A claim whose workspace is shared refuses MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_SHARED_MODE_UNSUPPORTED with no seat-job, and MOE_AGENT_SEAT_PATH is ignored under MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 (rows).

postflight-vm-route.ps1 passes alone under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and pwsh 7, postflight.ps1 passes under Windows PowerShell 5.1, bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh passes, and moe-agent.ps1 keeps its UTF-8 BOM.
taskRails: Never fall back to running the agent CLI on the host under verified-local.
Legacy stays byte-for-byte unchanged in behavior.
Port CQ-M07m3's landed behavior and strings verbatim; a credential never enters an argv, an env, a file or a log.
